svg.title: Insert (SW5) into the larger-width product. Interior heat factors combine by (SW6), exterior ones fix the vacuum, proving Mp+u = Mp. Comparison of any two admissible widths proves independence. For zi = iyi, recursively build the ket backwards: centered insertion plants at time p, and heat gap yi+1 −yi −2p with spatial translation places the remaining word. Vacuum pairing gives the complete Euclidean word up to a common translation, removed by invariance. Quotient- label identity identifies its union hierarchy value. Define Fn = Mp at strict times. An admissible p exists because there are finitely many positive imaginary gaps; the choice is irrelevant by width independence. Bounded composition makes Fn holomorphic in complex times and continuous in spatial positions. No regularity of a global width choice is required. Contractions and Cauchy– Schwarz give |Fn| ≤∥Ω∥2 Q i ∥Bp(vi)∥. For gaps at least 0 < k ≤1, choose p = k/8 to obtain
